<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Logo Niraf Digital</title>
    <style>
        body {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 100vh;
            margin: 0;
            background: #f5f5f5;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
        }
        .logo-container {
            text-align: center;
            background: white;
            padding: 40px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
        }
        img {
            max-width: 400px;
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
        }
        p {
            color: #666;
            margin-top: 15px;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="logo-container">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Logo Niraf Digital">
        <p>Niraf Digital - PPOB Pulsa Online</p>
    </div>
</body>
</html>
